basic_info.description: Beautiful Twin Peaks and South Water views from this high floor 2BR home at One Rincon Hill. Gorgeous new flooring, private deck, granite countertops, Sub-Zero Refrigerator, and unobstructed city and water views from every room. A private balcony, in-unit washer/dryer, and one valet parking space complete the home.    One Rincon Hill building amenities include outdoor BBQ area, pool, & whirlpool, Business Center, Meeting Room, Club Room, Sky Lounge, Fitness Center, and 24 hour lobby attendant. Concierge service with mail/package holding. One Car valet Parking included. One Rincon Hill has a dominating position at the top of Rincon Hill, which provides easy access to 101, 280, 80 and Bay Bridge. Walk to the Embarcadero, Financial District and Union Square.
